name: Builder Kit
tagline: The folder setup and agent cards we use to build every tool on this site.
audience: People building their own tools with AI
before: An AI build lives in one long chat with no rules. Around the half-hour mark it starts forgetting things and breaking what already worked.
after: A ready folder layout for your own computer: a read-only playbooks room, a room for each project, and short role cards that tell each AI agent its job.
